# Website Quality Audit: Contact Page Screenshot Analysis

## Overall Layout
The page features a **full-width hero section** with a dark overlay containing contact information and a form, set against a background image of gourmet appetizers. The layout uses a **two-column structure** below the hero: left column for contact details, right column for a contact form. The design employs a dark theme with high contrast between text and background.

## Color Scheme
- **Background**: Dark (near-black) with a semi-transparent overlay on the hero image
- **Text**: White for primary content, light gray for secondary text
- **Accent colors**: Gold/amber for the "с нами" portion of the main heading and phone number
- **Form fields**: Dark gray/black with white text
- **Social buttons**: Dark background with white text
- **WhatsApp icon**: Bright green circular button in bottom right corner

## Typography
- **Main heading**: "Свяжитесь с нами" uses a large, elegant serif font with "с нами" in gold/amber color
- **Body text**: Clean sans-serif font in white/light gray
- **Contact labels**: Uppercase sans-serif in light gray
- **Form fields**: Sans-serif font in white
- **Social media buttons**: Sans-serif font in white

## Spacing & Hierarchy
- **Hero section**: Generous vertical spacing with centered text
- **Contact information**: Well-spaced sections with clear hierarchy
- **Form fields**: Consistent vertical spacing with adequate padding
- **Social buttons**: Evenly spaced with appropriate margins

## Images
- **Background image**: High-quality photo of gourmet appetizers (possibly caviar-topped canapés) with a dark overlay to ensure text readability
- **WhatsApp icon**: Standard green WhatsApp logo in bottom right corner

## Visual Issues/Concerns
1. **Contrast issues**: Some form field text may have insufficient contrast against the dark background
2. **Form field visibility**: The dark form fields might be difficult to distinguish from the background
3. **Navigation clarity**: The breadcrumb navigation ("Главная — Контакты") is small and may be hard to read
4. **Mobile responsiveness**: The two-column layout may not adapt well to mobile screens
5. **Loading performance**: The large background image may impact page load time

## Content Organization
- Clear separation between contact information and form
- Logical grouping of contact details (phone, email, address, hours)
- Form fields appear to be properly labeled but may benefit from placeholder text for better UX

## Additional Notes
- The page appears to be for a catering service based in Saint Petersburg
- Contact information is prominently displayed
- Multiple contact methods are provided (phone, email, social media, form)
- The design suggests a premium/high-end service based on the imagery and typography

Overall, the page has good visual hierarchy and clear information architecture, but could benefit from improved contrast and mobile responsiveness optimization.
